title: storage/drivers: preserve parent mtime when relinking
body:
Fixes: https://github.com/podman-container-tools/container-libs/issues/1172

## Problem

ID shifting reconstructs hardlinks to keep overlay copy-up from splitting them.
Removing and relinking directory entries changes directory mtimes, including
when ownership already matches. Image materialization therefore changes metadata
unrelated to the requested ownership translation.

## Solution

Save the destination parent's mtime immediately before reconstruction and restore
it before releasing the existing hardlink mutex. Leave atime unchanged and
return restoration errors. Keep the timestamp local to that reconstruction.

## Changes

- Add a focused relink helper in `storage/drivers/chown_unix.go`.
- Add filesystem and mapping regressions covering concurrency, metadata, errors,
  and unchanged mappings.
- Add one stat and one timestamp update per duplicate hardlink; no extra work
  is added for ordinary non-hardlinked files.

## Verification

- Direct root filesystem regression: all five tests fail on the base; all five
  pass for 25 race-enabled repetitions with the patch (125 top-level passes,
  zero skips). This includes the real mapping/chroot path and capability checks.
- Standalone Podman 6.1.1 builds: the minimal image-materialization reproducer
  exits 1 before and 0 after. Unmapped and two mapped cases have no directory
  mtime mismatches with the candidate.
- The broader probe retains a separate failing ownership assertion: `/a` stays
  at host `0:0` in both stock and candidate. The patch preserves observed owners,
  but does not establish complete engine filesystem fidelity.
- `go vet`, formatting, and FreeBSD cross-compilation pass. The full repository
  CI matrix and non-Linux runtime tests were not run.

The focused commands were:

```sh
go test -overlay=before-overlay.json -count=1 -run '^TestLChown' -v ./storage/drivers
go test -count=1 -run '^TestLChown' -v ./storage/drivers
go test -race -count=25 -run '^TestLChown' ./storage/drivers
go vet ./storage/drivers
GOOS=freebsd GOARCH=amd64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go test -c -o drivers-freebsd.test ./storage/drivers
```

The root test binaries additionally exercised `TestChownPathByMapsPreservesMetadata`:

```sh
sudo ./before.test -test.v
sudo ./after.test -test.v -test.count=25
```

The before binaries retain the new tests and substitute the original production
implementation through a Go source overlay. The candidate root binary includes
the race detector. Full commands and hashes are recorded in `verification.md`.
